articles.title: Iran Publicly Rejects Trump's Talks Claim; Furious Trump Fires Back With 'Duplicitous' Attack
articles.description: Just hours after expressing confidence that negotiations with Iran were progressing, Donald Trump sharply changed his tone, accusing Tehran of deception and insisting US pressure would continue. Posting on Truth Social, Trump claimed Iranian leaders had privately sought talks while publicly denying direct negotiations with Washington. Iran rejected the allegation, maintaining it is only engaging with Oman over a temporary route through the Strait of Hormuz. The exchange comes after Trump suggested a breakthrough was close, following regional efforts to avoid further military escalation. With both sides publicly contradicting each other, uncertainty over diplomacy has returned, raising fresh questions about whether the latest round of negotiations can prevent another confrontation.
